_description: MediaPipe Face Mesh landmark indices used by Neulbom drowsiness + head-pose detector. Single source of truth shared by data_test/ (Python PoC) and web_pwa/ (browser PoC).
_model: MediaPipe Face Mesh (468 landmarks, refine_landmarks=False). Indices are stable across Python and JS SDKs.

head_pose._use: 2D anchors for cv2.solvePnP / equivalent PnP solver. Order MUST match face_model_3d.json.points.
